༄༅/ /dug nad sbyor ngan bcos pa'i yi ge pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba ā sī naṃ/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dug nad sbyor ngan bcos pa'i yi ge pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba ā sī naṃ// gti mug 'dod chags zhe sdang dug bcom nas// gzhan gyi dug rnams zhi mdzad drang srong che// sngon med sman pa'i mchog gyur 'jam dbyangs la// mchod nas sbyor ngan bcos thabs 'dir bshad do// dang po cham pa 'dra 'ong stod 'tshangs sdang*// ro rgyab gzer zhing grang dro gnyis mi bzod// chang 'thung pa la na zug tshugs pa med// so rtse mchin gsang skrangs dang rtsib ma 'phar// mdog 'gyur sog gzhug 'brum nag ston na zhel// mchin babs mig na glo ba'i sna skam zhing*// mcher pa'i mchu 'gas snying lce nag la thung*// snod kyi rna ba brgyangs 'dra mgo sgyur dka'// gdong spos 'brum bus btab dang 'khol bur bskrangs// brdol zhing mtha' ma za ba reg pa'i dug /'ga' zhig stod tsha smad grang 'khol bur 'phrig /skya rbab rmu rdzing mdze dang cha shas 'dra// rim gyis shed chung sha mdog nag por 'gyur// zug rngu chung dang dran pa nyams pa dang*// smyo dang 'bogs pa la sogs cir yang ston// rtsa ni ma nges 'gyur zhing smug po 'dra// khyad par 'phrig cing 'dar ba 'di la yod// chu yang 'gyur mang phal cher dmar ba dang*// nad chu li sder kha spyad nang btang rlangs ma yal// sas lcibs zhag lon 'ja' 'od gzhi la snang*// yang na nad chur bya pho'i ze khrag dang*// bong nga dkar po btab na rnag mdog ston// yang na chu gtsang nad du chu ma 'gul bar nyi ma'i zer la khyer// nad pa'i mchil gnyid sad 'drog btab mdung tshugs zug na yin// gzhan yang dri chu dkar gong bsregs dang sprad// lcags g.ya' chags 'dra ngos bzung 'di la ni// dug rigs sman mang btang na 'khrul ba srid// byer yun ring ba rlung bcos rtsa chu brtag /nad gzhan kha 'thor bcos nas gzhi ma spyad// kun gyis ma rtogs bsdu sman tho rangs gtong*// btsan dug dkar po chig thub dbang lag dang*// yungs kar phag nag po'i khrag bzang dug sna dang*// ril bu bsdu sman mchog yin chang gis 'phul// khong par btang na sbos 'khrog pho bar 'dril// bshal lam skyug na yin par 'khrul mi srid// ha cang bungs che bzod min phral la sbyangs// gzhan du ring du bsdu ste zas spyod sogs// gang gnod de dus bsten 'jug slong ba yin// bsdus rtags sngar bshad nyid phyir 'dir ma bzlas// phag pa'i khrag la rin chen ril bu sbyar// grang shas che na khrag chab se 'bru lnga// se 'bru suk+mel pi pi ling shing tshwa// gur kum cha mnyam sbyar ba 'di la bsngags// gung gnyis sten cing rin chen rnyed dka' na// ko ṭa suk+mel sman smug bong nga dmar// byang bul gser mdog sran nag sbyar bas bsad// de dus sdud pa'i dus su sman yang gtong*// de nas nad ro sbyang ba ko ṭa 'am// su mi sman nyung ma 'dra ba mon dug gtong ba'i gling du skye las 'chong 'dra'i tshig bshal lam// bse ru dkar dang suk+mel sman smug po// gla rtsi gser mdog dug dbyung dngul chu dang*// rgya tsha a ru mchu snyung rtse mo gsum// dong kha'i thog bzhi'i rus dor bshus pa'i rtsi// dur byid mtheb phyi lpags nag po'i rtsi phud/

yos sun gcig dang mnyam du brngos/ de nas snying po phung pa'i bar shun gtong tshigs tsam gyi lpags phral lam// yang na yos kyi khrod du btul na yin// 'di med bdud rtsi zar bu'i thar nu khaṇ+ḍa dang*// dan rog bdun gyi lce phyung rtsa sbyong na// byang nag bdun dang pi pi ling yod tsam// lhan du bsnur ba bsnan rnams ril bu sbyar// mkhan chus lus bkru mar phyi'i dril phyis bya// lcam pa zwa tshod g.yer btab thug pa ni// zhag gsum par btang de nas zla smad la// hor zla dgu pa'i nyer dgu'i nyin brko dus// mi dang ma phrad gnam ma mthong ba dang*// mtshon gyis ma reg rtsa ba ma lus phyungs// grib bskams bud med reg min ko ṭa de// gtun nang gtun bu phyir bstan 'bras nyag bcas// brdungs ba chang dang bcas pa lcag tu bzhag /de nas gos dro ril bu sran ma tsam// bco lnga lto ba bsra snyis bsnon 'bring dang*// nad pa 'tsho byed ngag bsdam phyi mas sngags// ko ṭa zhes pa mar gsar za zhing bzlas// lto 'phigs ko ṭa lcags ni zungs dang sbyar// gcod 'dod lcag bzhag mar gsar thug pa btang*// sman ma zhu na rgya tshwa'i thang gis bzhu// 'gyings na rgya tshwa'i thang la dung thal btab// srin ldang go bye mar dril gtong ba bsngags// bshal dag rlung yin de mnan 'dir 'bad bya// dug rigs kun la sbyong byed 'di nyid mchog yang na ko ṭa su mi sman smug po// lhan du sbyar ba'i thang gis lcag tu bya// 'jam 'dod de gnyis tshab tu lcum rtsa shis// bshal rjes mar gsar thug pa btsos pa'i zan// shin tu sla ba star kha'i snying po tsam// dang po nyin gsum phyi nas gar btang spar// zla ba'i bar bsten spyod lam shin tu gzab// bshal 'khrus sangs nas pho ba'i kha 'dzin bsten// nad pa zungs ngan de la sdud gsad mtshams// sbyongs dgos na yang zungs gsos de nas bya// so dang sen rgyab nag cing na zhing dmun// long na ko ṭa su mi then pa gnad// gur kum li shi gi waṃ bse ru dkar// tshal dang tsan dan dkar po gla rtsi dang*// 'jam 'bras gser mdog ru rta ba ru ra// bong nga dkar dang skyu ru ra rnams ni// phag pa'i khrag dang sbyar bas phyi rjes gcod// gi waṃ gur kum ut+pal ba le ka

/tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka /gser gyi me tog 'bras bu gsum khrag phag dang sbyar// phyi rjes gcod 'di mkhris pa can la mchog /reg dug tsha shos byung na ra tshil dang*// ga bur sbyar ba phyir byug ra khrag dang*// gur kum bcu gsum sbyar ba nang du btang*// yang na ra khrag ga pur sbyar ba'ang rung*// grang shos brag zhun be be shing sdong po'i khrag khrag gla rtsi dang*// snye ma'i khaṇ+ḍa gu gul shing kun dang*// skog gcig dza ti ra khrag sbyar ba ni// phyir byug nang la chang gis 'phul gyin btang*// btsan dug sha dug sha nad rigs kun la// byang bul lhad med bongs chen thang gi gzhom// sbrang smyon byung na g.yar ma'i thang gis sel// da ni bsrung ba'i bya ra lce rgya ston// lce steng lug sha gsar pa za yun sbyar// dmar bar gyur nas rgya tshwa'i sran ma tsam phye mas mnan// brtol ba tsam tshad btsan dug phye ma btab// de kha gser mdog a ru ra 'bigs byed phye mas bkus// rtsi gu bkab ste yun ring bzhag nas bkru// dug can zas phrad lce sbid tsha dbal 'byung*// la phug g.yer ma za ba spang bya yin// nyi nub dus su g.yer chu khong du btang*// nam phyed rin chen ril bu mid nas su// skya rengs dus su dom mkhris mar khur sbyar// 'thungs bas rtsa kha bsdams te nyal po dang*// rtsa kha 'byed pa'i rigs gyur kun spangs na// zas ngan khong du song tshe bshal skyug gam// min kyang sgregs par gla rtsi'i dri bro 'byung*// de tshe bcos thabs kun la nan tan byos// de skad res 'ga' sman pa'i drang srong khrod// khengs pa'i ri bo bsnyil la shes pa'i tshul// gnam lcags 'bar ba 'dra bar 'bebs byed pa'i// blo gsal dbang po pad+ma dkar pos sbyar// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //
